scripts.typecheck: wrangler types -c wrangler.jsonc && react-router typegen && tsc -b
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:test: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env test -c wrangler.jsonc && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=test react-router build && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:live: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env live -c wrangler.jsonc && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=live react-router build && wrangler deploy
